failures.rule: brand/constitution.md E1, E2 and Article 1.4; product/ui-constitution.md Article 7
failures.place: Both phones: white curves behind the card title, amount, deadline and outlined action
failures.issue: The thick, high-contrast curves form a competing graphic foreground. They run through the text and the transparent secondary button, making the seller scan patterned content to find the amount and next action. Strong texture is an allowed D5 candidate, but here its prominence defeats the required calm, item-first hierarchy.

across_options.issue: Header band also adds a visible outline around the top card and makes it the same white outlined surface as the lower cards. Moving the field necessarily changes its ground, but the added border changes D4 surface treatment as well as D5 location.

On the Sold screen, Whole moment removes the top card boundary and changes the lower rows from outlined cards on white to opaque white cards on color. This changes D4 grouping and surface hierarchy alongside field placement. The Offer screen stays in the original treatment.

The texture variants do not only increase line strength. Strong lines changes the curves to a tighter fan with near-vertical strokes at the upper left and near-horizontal strokes at the lower right; the underlying lower-right lime also appears brighter. Medium lines changes the visible curve spacing and trajectory relative to the faint base. The comparison therefore mixes texture strength, pattern geometry and apparent color intensity.
